title: PPW observed-run distributions, four survey weekdays
quantile_method: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p (Hyndman-Fan type 7). Quantiles describe observed runs; not confidence intervals.
limitations: Two Tuesdays and two Wednesdays, with only two survey days per wave. No inference about day-to-day reliability.
Repeated runs within a day are not independent policy experiments.
Road segment times, not complete journey times.
P90 for six peak-period runs is interpolated from the two slowest observed runs; highly unstable.
Before May 11-12 and after October 19-20, 2010. Saturday runs excluded for aligned weekday comparison.
